name: How does AKN Design Group ensure the structural integrity of roof framing during a major renovation?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure the structural integrity of roof framing during a major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures structural integrity through our integrated design-build approach, which includes detailed engineering and permit coordination from the outset. Before construction begins, our team, alongside structural engineers, develops precise plans for the roof framing, considering load calculations, material specifications, and architectural aesthetics. During construction, our experienced craftspeople adhere strictly to these approved plans and relevant building codes. This managed process, with a single point of coordination, mitigates risks associated with complex structural changes and ensures the roof framing is robust and reliable, providing peace of mind to homeowners investing in substantial renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group ensures roof framing integrity through detailed engineering, permit coordination, and strict adherence to plans during construction, all part of our integrated design-build process.
